updates.note: Mentioned that credit cost came in at INR 3,625 crores or 1.91% annualized, within the guided range.
updates.quote: Annualized number came in at 1.91%. After a while we've seen a sub 2% number.

updates.note: Reiterated that AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, more likely 22% on a full year basis.
updates.quote: overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.

updates.note: Updated COF guidance range from 7.5%-7.55% to 7.55%-7.60%.
updates.quote: We're likely to be between 7.55% to 7.60% in terms of cost of funds as we exit the year.

updates.note: Raised customer addition target for FY26 to 17-18 million.
updates.quote: We now expect 17 to 18 million customers to be added to the franchise in FY '26.

updates.note: Mentioned MSME grew in quarter 3 by 11% and slow down will take another 2-3 quarters.
updates.quote: Given the actions that we have taken in the MSME business, that's something that you'll see, which has grown in this -- in quarter 3 only by 11%.

new_promises.statement: We are well on course to cross 120 million franchise in the current year.
new_promises.quote: We are well on course to cross 120 million franchise in the current year.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: We foresee that we will be a 200 million customer company in the next 3 to 4 years.
new_promises.quote: We foresee that we will be a 200 million customer company in the next 3 to 4 years' time.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: We expect that by May-June 2027, we'll have an altogether new Consumer AI platform.
new_promises.quote: We expect that by May-June '27, we'll have an altogether new Consumer AI platform for us as a firm
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: We would have 800+ autonomous agents across sales, operations, HR, IT, risk and DMS in the next fiscal.
new_promises.quote: We believe that the company would have 800+ autonomous agents across sales, operations, HR, IT, risk and DMS in the next fiscal.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain
